summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked). Research design only; no Nepal values are recorded. Q1: every trajectory is specified as src.economic_model.projection.ProjectionAssumptions fields with each input mapped to a pending observation (INP-01..INP-09) or a labelled assumption: two untargeted baselines (TR-0a constant historical trend; TR-0b regression to the mean per Pritchett-Summers), required paths to FY labels 2050, 2060 and 2070 in two shapes (S1 constant; S2 lag-peak-decay parameterised by 06C delivery lags and 01B spell durations) and shock overlays from 16C. Q2: the formula set F1-F13 gives required nominal USD, real, per-capita and labour-productivity growth, implied investment ratio and the valuation share; NPR/USD is derived as peg ratio x INR/USD (03A) and USD price growth is decomposed into US inflation, INR real appreciation and the Nepal-India differential so each component is bounded by its own evidence. Q3: ten sensitivity axes (SG-01..SG-10) with evidence sources. Ten feasibility tests (FT-01..FT-10) and six unattainability conditions (U1-U6) are pre-registered for r2. A USD-conversion convention is proposed for ESC-03 (01C-P-ESC03: NSO FY GDP / NRB same-FY average of daily middle NPR/USD, FY labelled by ending year). The only numbers are a hypothetical illustration computed from config/model_config.yaml assumptions A-TGT-01..07; they are not estimates of Nepal. All empirical items are pending.

assumptions.text: Trajectories are accounting paths built with src.economic_model.projection.project; they are stress tests and requirement calculations, not forecasts, and carry no probabilities.
Base year = latest Nepal FY with an NSO 'revised' nominal GDP estimate; the latest 'preliminary' FY is a sensitivity (SG-01). Config A-TGT-01 remains a placeholder label until INP-01 is retrieved.

TR-0a real growth = mean spliced real growth over the longest available window, excluding FY2015/16-FY2016/17 (earthquake/blockade) and FY2019/20-FY2020/21 (pandemic) as flagged by 01A; the window choice is reported with alternatives.
TR-0b applies geometric regression of growth toward a world long-run mean, with mean and half-life taken from 01B / Pritchett-Summers (2014) evidence once retrieved; no parameter value is set in r1.
NPR/USD paths are never an independent trend: 1+d = (1+d_peg)(1+d_INR), with d_peg = 0 while the peg holds and parity changes modelled only as discrete scenario steps (adopts 03A-A1).

Nepal deflator paths are specified as India deflator growth times a Nepal-India differential, and USD price growth is decomposed into US inflation, INR real appreciation vs USD and NPR real appreciation vs INR (F5), so each component can be bounded by its own evidence.
Shape S2 (lag, peak, decay) is parameterised by 06C delivery-lag quantiles and 01B spell durations; the decay form is geometric toward the TR-0b mean.

FY population = geometric mean of WPP 1 July values of the two calendar years the FY spans (FY t ~ midpoint mid-January t); FY population growth derived from these. Resident concept only (10C rule; C-06).

Scenario shocks enter trajectories only through Path.shifted on real_growth, deflator_growth or fx_depreciation as implemented in src/scenario_engine/engine.py; population shocks require an engine change and are not applied in r2 unless added.
A-TGT-04 cases in config/model_config.yaml are retained only as hypothetical grid points; evidence-based cases PF-1..PF-5 replace them once INP-03..INP-07 are retrieved.
The order in which unattainability conditions are expected to bind by milestone is a research-sequencing expectation, not a finding.

PROPOSAL for ESC-03 (to be registered by 00A, decided by a human reviewer): headline USD GDP = NSO FY nominal GDP / NRB same-FY average of daily middle NPR/USD rates, FY labelled by ending calendar year; WDI/WEO/SNAAMA reproduced as separate cross-checks; projected NPR/USD = peg x INR/USD.

challenges.text: Please register proposal 01C-P-ESC03 (USD-conversion convention) in config/model_config.yaml as a labelled assumption for human decision under ESC-03, and add assumption slots for INR/USD path, peg ratio and the Nepal-India deflator differential so price/FX cases are not expressed as independent NPR depreciation (A-TGT-04a-d conflict with 03A-A1).
02C finding (fiscal/debt financing limits) is absent from research/findings/02/ in r1; FT-03 cannot be fully specified. Please schedule 02C or confirm which agent supplies debt-stabilising limits.

Only S04-d and S05-d (real_growth) enter the projection; no scenario has a deflator_growth or fx_depreciation shock, so a peg adjustment or INR shock cannot be stress-tested. Please propose (for human review) an fx_depreciation channel (peg step, INR/USD shock) and a deflator_growth channel (oil price pass-through).

Please deliver the rate-duration upper envelope: for each horizon N from 20 to 50 years, the maximum and upper percentiles of average real GDP and GDP-per-capita growth sustained over N consecutive years, by spell definition, with the landlocked subset (INP-09); FT-01 needs N matched to each milestone.
Please report ICOR by window with dispersion and flag status, and name the window you consider the most defensible trend for real growth (TR-0a), with alternatives.

Please provide single-year WPP 2024 resident totals for all variants so that 01C-A07 FY conversion can be applied; confirm whether WPP's Nepal population is a resident concept consistent with the SNA residency of GDP (C-06/ESC-04).

Adopted: quantiles P50/P75/P90 of approval_lag_years and execution_rate will be passed as separate stress settings (SG-10, FT-04). Please also supply the physical-unit mapping from investment spending to delivered assets for the public programme.
Please treat FT-09 (base-year identity, peg residual, convention invariance) as a precondition for any VERIFIED verdict on TGT-ARITH trajectories.
Please review the PF-4 (valuation-driven) and PF-5 (peg adjustment) cases for geopolitical plausibility; a milestone reached only under PF-4 will be labelled valuation-dependent.

uncertainty: All empirical uncertainty is unresolved because no input has been retrieved. Structurally, the required real growth is most sensitive to (i) the base-year USD GDP level, which depends on the USD-conversion convention and NSO vintage (C-01/C-02), (ii) assumed USD price growth, which enters one-for-one in log terms and is itself the product of three uncertain components (US inflation, INR real appreciation, Nepal-India differential) plus the peg, and (iii) the milestone horizon; the hypothetical illustration shows that a half-year label shift alone changes the required USD CAGR noticeably at the 2050 horizon. Feasibility conclusions will additionally depend on the choice of spell definition (01B), ICOR window (01A), delivery quantiles (06C) and population variant (10C); results will be reported across these rather than at a single point, with no probabilities.

required_growth_table.status: pending (formulas final; all empirical inputs pending)

notation.d_peg: growth of NPR per INR (0 while the peg holds)

formulas.name: base USD GDP
formulas.expr: USD0 = Y0 / E0; peg check: E0 ~ P0 * X0 (FY averages; residual reported against tolerances.source_conflict_rel_tol)

formulas.name: USD price growth
formulas.expr: 1+p = (1+pi)/(1+d) = (1+pi_US)(1+q_IN)(1+q_NP)/(1+d_peg)  [growth.usd_price_growth; decomposition identity follows from F4 and the q definitions]

formulas.name: time-varying paths
formulas.expr: project(ProjectionAssumptions, M) then first_year_reaching(rows, T); for S2 shapes solve g_peak by bisection on the crossing year

formulas.name: external financing need
formulas.expr: CAD/Y = I/Y - S_nat/Y (S_nat from GNDI incl. remittances; 02C/03C/IMF DSA supply limits)

required_growth_table.rows_specification: One row per (milestone M in 2050/2060/2070) x (price/FX case PF-1..PF-5) x (population variant WPP24 MED/LOW/HIGH/ZM) x (ICOR from 01A windows), with columns g_usd, p, g_real, g_pc, y_M, I/Y, g_lp, s_price; plus the untargeted TR-0a/b arrival years.

hypothetical_illustration.label: HYPOTHETICAL ILLUSTRATION - computed only from config/model_config.yaml assumptions A-TGT-01 (grid base-year label), A-TGT-02 (hypothetical base grid), A-TGT-03 (illustrative base), A-TGT-04a-d (price/FX cases), A-TGT-05 (ICOR grid), A-TGT-06 (continuation growth), A-TGT-07 (hypothetical populations). NOT estimates of Nepal's GDP, prices, exchange rate or population, and not forecasts. Produced with src.economic_model.target and growth.
reading_notes: Rows flagged investment_rate_above_one imply gross investment exceeding GDP under at least one ICOR in the A-TGT-05 grid; such a path is arithmetically defined but physically unattainable without external financing larger than the economy.

price_share_of_log_usd_growth = ln(1+USD price growth)/ln(1+required USD growth): the part of the required USD growth that the case assigns to prices and exchange rate rather than volume. A high share means the target is met by valuation, not output (welfare.py tracks the difference).

half_year_label_shift_rows show how much the required USD CAGR moves if the milestone is read half a year earlier (the FY-vs-CY labelling question in ESC-03); USD CAGR is independent of the price/FX case, so one case is shown.

sensitivity_grid.method: One-at-a-time sweeps of each axis around the PF-2 / WPP24-MED / central-ICOR reference, plus a full factorial of SG-01 x SG-03/04 x milestone (the headline sensitivity asked in Q3). Report d(g_real_req)/d(axis) and the change in TR-0 crossing year. No probabilities are attached (01B-A5).

axes.levels: NSO/NRB-FY convention value; WDI; WEO; UN SNAAMA (each reproduced from its own NPR GDP and FX); preliminary vs revised base FY; config A-TGT-02 hypothetical grid until then
FY label M; CY M via geometric mean of FY M and FY M+1; half-year shift

axes.axis: Nepal GDP deflator growth (pi), decomposed as pi_IN and q_NP
axes.levels: historical-window quartiles of pi_IN and q_NP
quartiles of rolling 10/20/30-year INR/USD depreciation (Nepal-FY aligned)
peg holds; one discrete parity change in a stated year (sizes from historical NPR/INR changes, 03A/20B)
S1 constant; S2 lag-peak-decay with L at 06C P50/P75/P90 and D at 01B spell-duration quartiles
01A window values (non-flagged windows), comparator values from PWT; config A-TGT-05 retained only as a labelled grid
WPP 2024 MED, LOW, HIGH, CF, ZM, probabilistic 80/95 bounds; NSO projection to its horizon; A-TGT-07 as fallback grid
06C P50/P75/P90 execution_rate and approval_lag_years passed as separate stress settings (06C challenge)

sensitivity_grid.headline_outputs_q3: Elasticity of g_real_req to (a) base USD GDP, (b) USD price growth p (via SG-03/04/05), and (c) the milestone label; and the range of TR-0 crossing years across PF-1..PF-5.

feasibility_tests.name: Growth-spell precedent (01B)
feasibility_tests.test: For each TR-M-S1: compare g_real_req and g_pc_req, sustained for n = M - b years, with the 01B rate-duration envelope (INP-09) under each of the three spell definitions and for the landlocked subset. For TR-M-S2: compare (g_peak, D) jointly. Apply Pritchett-Summers persistence evidence.
feasibility_tests.pass: requirement lies at or below the envelope for at least one definition
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: 'without historical precedent' if above the maximum for every definition; 'no landlocked precedent' reported separately

feasibility_tests.name: Investment ratio vs ICOR history (01A)
feasibility_tests.test: I/Y = ICOR x g_real_req using the 01A non-flagged ICOR windows; compare with Nepal's historical GFCF/GDP maximum and the maximum sustained investment share among 01B spells (PWT csh_i).
feasibility_tests.pass: implied I/Y within the maximum sustained comparator investment share at the lowest evidenced ICOR
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: I/Y above comparator maximum at every evidenced ICOR; I/Y above one = arithmetically unattainable

feasibility_tests.name: Financing (02C, 03B, 03C, 03A, IMF DSA)
feasibility_tests.test: Financing gap = I/Y - national saving/Y (GNDI basis incl. remittances); compare the implied current-account deficit and external-debt path with IMF DSA thresholds, 02C fiscal limits, 03B bank-credit capacity and 03C primary-issuance capacity (not market capitalisation, per 03C), and with the reserve cover needed to keep the peg (03A).
feasibility_tests.pass: external debt/GDP stabilises below the DSA threshold and reserve cover stays above the 03A floor
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: financing need exceeds all evidenced domestic plus external capacity

feasibility_tests.name: Delivery constraints (06C)
feasibility_tests.test: Translate the public share of implied investment into physical programmes and run constraints.constrained_delivery with 06C P50/P75/P90 approval_lag_years, execution_rate and max_units_per_year; require that delivered capital meets the path's capital requirement.
feasibility_tests.pass: delivered capital >= required capital under P50 settings, with the P90 shortfall reported
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: requirement exceeds delivery even if capacity grows at the fastest evidenced rate

feasibility_tests.name: Labour supply (10C, 10B, 09A)
feasibility_tests.test: Employment path = resident working-age population (10C variant) x participation x (1 - unemployment) (10B); implied g_lp = (1+g_real)/(1+g_L)-1; compare with the maximum sustained output-per-worker growth among comparators (PWT) and with learning-adjusted human capital (09A LAYS).
feasibility_tests.pass: g_lp within the comparator envelope under the High and Zero-migration variants
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: g_lp above envelope under every population variant

feasibility_tests.name: Energy and sector value-added consistency (05A, 07A, 08A, 12A)
feasibility_tests.test: Sector growth enters only through value added (sectors.py): sector VA paths from 05A (electricity incl. exports subject to transmission), 07A (agriculture), 08A (ICT services) and 12A (goods exports) must sum to the aggregate g_real path; electricity demand implied by the path must be met by the 05A pipeline at evidenced completion rates.
feasibility_tests.pass: sector VA sum reconciles within identity tolerance without an unexplained residual sector
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: a residual sector must grow faster than any evidenced sector growth

feasibility_tests.name: Valuation vs volume and peg consistency (03A)
feasibility_tests.test: Compute s_price (F11). Price/FX paths must satisfy F4 with the peg; q_IN and q_NP beyond their historical upper quartiles are flagged. Any milestone reached only under PF-4 is labelled 'valuation-dependent' and reported with welfare.py indicators.
feasibility_tests.pass: milestone reached under PF-2 without relying on out-of-range valuation
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: milestone reached only by valuation outside evidenced ranges

feasibility_tests.name: Shock robustness (16C)
feasibility_tests.test: Apply S04-d, S05-d and S10 overlays; report crossing-year shift and recovery growth.
feasibility_tests.pass: recovery growth remains within FT-01 envelope
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: a single scenario pushes the requirement beyond FT-01

feasibility_tests.name: Arithmetic integrity and convention invariance
feasibility_tests.test: project() reproduces USD0 exactly in the base year (identity_rel_tol); F1 peg residual within tolerance; milestone crossing identical under FY-average vs CY-aligned conventions, otherwise ESC-03 is triggered.
feasibility_tests.pass: all identities hold; convention does not move a crossing year
feasibility_tests.fail_flag: crossing year depends on convention -> escalate ESC-03 to human reviewer and 15A/28E

feasibility_tests.name: Trade-offs with the other objectives (welfare.py)
feasibility_tests.test: For each path passing FT-01..FT-09, report the welfare.py objective indicators; a path that meets the GDP milestone by degrading another objective is reported as a trade-off, never optimised away.

unattainability_conditions.general_rule: The target is unattainable by milestone M (labelled 'unattainable on current evidence', not a probability) if ANY of U1-U6 holds for every admissible price/FX case PF-1..PF-4 (PF-5 reported separately).

conditions.condition: USD0 * [(1+g_max(n))(1+p_max)]**n < T, where g_max(n) is the maximum real growth sustained for n years in the 01B envelope and p_max the upper-quartile USD price growth (SG-03/04)
ICOR_min_evidenced x g_real_req(M) exceeds the maximum sustained investment share observed among comparators (or exceeds one)
(I/Y - S_nat/Y) implies an external-debt path breaching the DSA threshold or reserve cover below the peg floor, for the entire horizon
required capital delivery exceeds constrained_delivery output under 06C P50 settings with capacity growth at its fastest evidenced rate
required labour-productivity growth exceeds the comparator envelope under every WPP 2024 variant including Zero-migration
sector VA reconciliation requires a residual sector growing faster than any evidenced sector (energy, agriculture, ICT, goods exports)

by_milestone.binding_first: U1 and U2 are expected to be tested first because n is shortest; which binds is pending r2 values
U1/U2 then U3 (financing accumulates with n)
U1 (duration of spell) and U5 (demographic ageing after the 10C dividend window) become relatively more important

unattainability_conditions.note: The 'binding_first' ordering is a research-design expectation for sequencing r2 work, not a result; it is an assumption (01C-A10).

usd_conversion_proposal_esc03.to: 00A (register in config/model_config.yaml via Agent 00; human reviewer decides per ESC-03)

proposal.headline_convention: USD GDP(FY t) = NSO nominal GDP for FY t (latest NSO release; revision status recorded) / NRB NPR-per-USD average for the same FY t (arithmetic mean of daily NRB middle rates = (buying+selling)/2 over 16 July to 15 July; NRB-published FY average recorded as a second observation). Label FY t by its ending calendar year (FY2049/50 -> 2050), consistent with projection.py period_convention.
proposal.milestone_definition: 'US$3T by M' = first FY label <= M with USD GDP >= T. CY-equivalent crossing (geometric mean of adjacent FY values) reported alongside, never substituted.
proposal.cross_checks: WDI NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, IMF WEO NGDPD and UN SNAAMA each reproduced from their own NPR GDP and FX (C-02) and kept as separate observations with the reproduction residual.
proposal.projection_fx: Projected NPR/USD = peg ratio x INR/USD FY averages (03A-A1); d_peg = 0 unless a scenario states a parity change.

rationale: Tier-1 sources for both numerator and denominator (NSO, NRB).
Numerator and denominator cover the same 12 months; no FY/CY mixing (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
Matches the engine's period convention, so no conversion step is needed in project().
Reproducible from daily data (NRB API), independent of third-party vintage.

alternatives_considered.reason_not_proposed: tier 2, vintage lag, year-label mapping must be inferred; kept as cross-check

alternatives_considered.option: CY-average FX applied to FY GDP

alternatives_considered.reason_not_proposed: stock-flow mismatch for a flow aggregate

usd_conversion_proposal_esc03.escalation_trigger: If FT-09 shows the convention changes any crossing year, ESC-03 moves from 'watch' to 'open' and goes to the human reviewer with both positions, and to 15A/28E.
